info.name: 101303788_COMP3123_Assignment1
info.description: All endpoints with success and failure cases. Run the folders in order (or use Run collection). Each run creates fresh users (alice_<runId>, bob_<runId>) so it can be run again. Restart the server before re-running to reset the rate limit counters.

request.description: Clients cannot choose the owner; it always comes from the JWT.

item.name: Get employee that does not exist

exec: pm.test("Does not contain user A's employee", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().employees.map(e => e._id)).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("empA")));

request.description: Login allows 5 failed attempts per 15 minutes. Earlier folders already used 2. Send this request until the response is 429 Too Many Requests (about 4 times).

exec: pm.test("401 until the limit is reached, then 429", () => pm.expect([401, 429]).to.include(pm.response.code));
